diagnosis: The scenario fails the Weak Arm gate because check C1, which is supposed to depend on the hidden fact PF1 (55-kilowatt startup load), is being satisfied by the model using only public information. In all four rollouts, the model correctly assigns G-1 to the Water Plant without any access to PF1, likely due to a default heuristic or pattern-matching the generator assignment based on the target name.

C1.why: The 55-kilowatt 0600-0800 startup load changes the water plant's generator assignment to G-1 and requires the facilities update to be documented.

fix_instructions: Tighten check C1 by requiring the model to explicitly mention the specific 55-kilowatt startup load or the 0600-0800 time window in its justification to ensure it has actually accessed the information contained in PF1.
